records.title: LinVT: Empower Your Image-level Large Language Model to Understand Videos
records.reason: The primary text introduces a video tokenizer that condenses redundant visual information, so a resource effect is plausible. However, the reported results emphasize video-understanding accuracy and training-data efficiency; no inference latency, memory, or compute comparison establishing LLM-serving efficiency was found in the checked sections. Keep as borderline for this inference-focused scope.

records.title: ALR2: A Retrieve-then-Reason Framework for Long-context Question Answering
records.reason: ALR2 uses retrieval before reasoning to improve long-context QA accuracy; the primary abstract reports no inference-compute, latency, memory, or serving optimization.

records.title: SmileyLlama: modifying large language models for directed chemical space exploration
records.reason: SmileyLlama is created through supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization for chemical generation; no inference-efficiency contribution is reported.

records.title: SpotDAG: An RL-Based Algorithm for DAG Workflow Scheduling in Heterogeneous Cloud Environments
records.reason: SpotDAG schedules generic cloud DAG workflows on spot instances; it is not an LLM inference or serving method.

records.title: PyGim : An Efficient Graph Neural Network Library for Real Processing-In-Memory Architectures
records.reason: PyGim targets graph neural network kernels on processing-in-memory hardware, not LLM inference.
